out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST140/ST36 round but =0 on 100% of 2,137,588 in-sample records (W1 §5). USER-CONFIRMED 2026-06-10: it IS a real progressive jackpot store, but the CURRENT testspin interface forces its accumulation efficiency to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse the data as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST140/ST36 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. RTP 92.17% is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
